title: Every small etale covering family is an fpqc covering
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $(f_i:U_i\to U)$ be any covering family in its small etale site $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Then $(f_i)_i$ is an fpqc covering of $U$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]: each $f_i$ is flat, and for every affine open $V\subseteq U$ there are finitely many indices $i_j$ and affine opens $V_j\subseteq U_{i_j}$ whose images under $f_{i_j}$ have union exactly $V$.

source.place: Tag 022C (topologies-lemma-zariski-etale-smooth-syntomic-fppf-fpqc), lines 3043–3077; specialized to etale coverings; also Tag 03O4 (etale-cohomology-remark-fpqc-finest), etale-cohomology.tex lines 1086–1095

proof.text: Let $(f_i:U_i\to U)_{i\in I}$ be a covering family of $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$. By the definition of the covering families of $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], each $f_i$ is an etale morphism, and by the definition of etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] (locally of finite presentation, flat and unramified) each $f_i$ is flat. This is the first clause of [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering].

source.place: Tag 022C (topologies-lemma-zariski-etale-smooth-syntomic-fppf-fpqc), proof, lines 3050-3065 ("By definition this means that the $f_i$ are flat")

proof.text: Let $V\subseteq U$ be an affine open, so $V$ with its open subscheme structure is an affine scheme. For $i\in I$ put $W_i=f_i^{-1}(V)$, an open subscheme of $U_i$, and let $g_i:W_i\to V$ be the restriction of $f_i$, so that $j_V\circ g_i=f_i\circ j_{W_i}$ for the inclusions $j_V:V\hookrightarrow U$ and $j_{W_i}:W_i\hookrightarrow U_i$, which are open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation] (1) the open immersions $j_{W_i}$ and $j_V$ are etale, by (2) the composite $f_i\circ j_{W_i}=j_V\circ g_i$ is etale, and by (3), applied to $g_i$ followed by the etale $j_V$, each $g_i$ is etale. The family $(g_i)_{i\in I}$ is jointly surjective onto $V$: for $v\in V$ the covering family is jointly surjective, so $v=f_i(x)$ for some $i$ and $x\in U_i$, and then $x\in f_i^{-1}(V)=W_i$ and $g_i(x)=v$.

source.place: Tag 022C (topologies-lemma-zariski-etale-smooth-syntomic-fppf-fpqc), proof, lines 3050-3065 (the restriction of the family over the affine open $V$); Tag 0218 (topologies-lemma-etale-affine)

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-affine-refinement] to the affine scheme $V$ and the jointly surjective family of etale morphisms $(g_i:W_i\to V)_{i\in I}$ of step 2: there are $m\ge0$, indices $i(1),\dots,i(m)\in I$ and affine open subschemes $V_j\subseteq W_{i(j)}$ with $V=\bigcup_{j=1}^m g_{i(j)}(V_j)$. Since $W_{i(j)}$ is open in $U_{i(j)}$, each $V_j$ is an affine open of $U_{i(j)}$, and $f_{i(j)}(V_j)=g_{i(j)}(V_j)$ because $g_{i(j)}$ is the restriction of $f_{i(j)}$. Hence $V=\bigcup_{j=1}^m f_{i(j)}(V_j)$. (This lemma carries the argument of the source: etale morphisms are open, the images of affine opens covering the $W_i$ form an open covering of $V$, and $V$ is quasi-compact.)

source.place: Tag 022C (topologies-lemma-zariski-etale-smooth-syntomic-fppf-fpqc), proof, lines 3050-3065 (each $f_i$ is open, $V=\bigcup_i\bigcup_j f_i(V_{ij})$ is an open covering, $V$ quasi-compact gives a finite refinement); Tag 0218 (topologies-lemma-etale-affine)

proof.text: Steps 1 and 3 are the two clauses of [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering] for the family $(f_i)_{i\in I}$ over $U$ (with $n=m$, $i_j=i(j)$ and the affine opens $V_j$ of step 3), so $(f_i)_{i\in I}$ is an fpqc covering of $U$; the explicit form of the conclusion in the statement is the same two clauses.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks Topologies Lemma 022C (tag verified in tags/tags; topologies.tex 3043-3065) and Remark 03O4 (etale-cohomology.tex 1086-1095), the definitions def-weil-pbc-etale-site (covering families are jointly surjective families of etale morphisms) and def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering (flat, and every affine open of the target is a finite union of images of affine opens), and the only citer lem-weil-pbc-small-etale-representable-presheaf-sheaf, whose step uses only that an etale covering family is an fpqc covering; the statement is kept. Proof in four steps following 022C: flatness from the definition of etale; restriction of the family over an affine open V to an etale jointly surjective family g_i: f_i^{-1}(V) -> V (open immersions etale, composition and cancellation: lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation); the finite affine refinement over the affine V by the existing Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-affine-refinement (Tag 0218, which carries 022C's openness plus quasi-compactness argument); the two clauses of the fpqc definition. No new node.
